job.title: Transport Supervisor
job.description:
Leadership Role | High-Impact Position | Genuine Career Progression
Are you an experienced Transport Supervisor who is ready to take the next step in your career?
Do you have a strong track record of leading transport teams, driving operational standards and delivering excellent customer service - and are you now looking for an opportunity that could develop into a management position?
If you are a motivated, results-driven and commercially aware transport professional with ambition to progress, this could be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.
The position is based in Reading.
The Opportunity
A highly successful and growing international organisation is looking to appoint an experienced Transport Supervisor to play a key role within its transport operation.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Supervisor who is ready to broaden their responsibilities, develop their leadership capability and build towards a future Transport Management position.
This is not simply a supervisory role. You will be actively involved in leading the transport operation, developing people, improving performance and ensuring the highest standards of safety, compliance and customer service.
For the right individual, this role offers a fantastic platform to accelerate your career within a business that invests heavily in its people and leadership talent.
About the Business
Our client is part of a dynamic and financially secure international organisation operating at the forefront of the UK service sector.
Every day the business supports organisations that impact the lives of millions of people across the UK, delivering essential services with a relentless focus on quality and customer experience.
The company also holds Gold EcoVadis status, placing it among the top 5% of over 125,000 companies globally for sustainability and responsible business practices.
People are at the heart of everything they do, and they are committed to building an environment where talented individuals can develop, grow and succeed.
The Role
As Transport Supervisor, you will support the day-to-day leadership of the transport operation, working closely with the management team to ensure it runs safely, efficiently and to the highest operational standards.
Key areas of focus include:
· Leading, motivating and developing a high-performing transport team
· Supervising day-to-day transport operations and driver performance
· Ensuring compliance with transport legislation, Health & Safety requirements and operational standards
· Supporting effective planning, scheduling and resource allocation
· Monitoring fleet and transport performance and identifying opportunities for improvement
· Driving operational efficiency and continuous improvement
· Delivering exceptional levels of customer service
· Supporting the management team with operational and commercial objectives
· Dealing proactively with operational issues and ensuring appropriate corrective action is taken
· Creating a positive, professional and high-accountability team culture
· Supporting the development and implementation of improved processes and ways of working
· Taking increasing responsibility as your experience and capability develops
This is a high-visibility role where your ability to lead from the front, organise effectively and drive results will make a real difference.
Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for an experienced and ambitious Transport Supervisor who is ready to take the next step in their career and develop towards a future management position.
You will bring:
· Proven experience supervising or leading a transport operation
· Strong knowledge of transport operations and driver management
· A genuine passion for operational excellence and customer service
· Strong leadership and people-management skills
· The confidence to make decisions and take ownership of operational issues
· A proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement
· Good commercial awareness and an understanding of operational costs and performance
· Strong communication and organisational skills
· The ambition and desire to progress into a Transport Management role
A CPC Transport Manager qualification would be advantageous, but is not essential for the right candidate. The business is particularly interested in individuals who have the experience, leadership capability and ambition to develop into a management position.
Experience with budgets, fleet performance, compliance or Health & Safety would also be beneficial, along with qualifications such as NEBOSH or IOSH.
Why This Role Stands Out
This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Transport Supervisor who feels ready for more responsibility and wants to build a long-term career within a successful international organisation.
You will benefit from:
· Being part of a successful international group
· A people-first culture where leadership is valued
· Genuine career progression into management
· The opportunity to develop your leadership and commercial skills
· The chance to influence, improve and shape the transport operation
· Support and investment in your professional development
· Working within a business committed to sustainability and long-term growth
Ready for the Next Step?
If you are an experienced Transport Supervisor who is ready to take the next step, wants to develop into a management role and is looking for an organisation that will invest in your potential, we would love to hear from you.
This could be the opportunity to turn your supervisory experience into your next management career move.

job.description:
My client is a leading supplier of Agricultural Irrigation and Dirty Water Dispersal Equipment and they are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Sales Manager / Technical Sales Manager to join an established UK manufacturer operating within the mechanised irrigation and water management sector.
This is a key role within the business, combining business development, technical sales, system design, customer relationship management and field-based support.

Our ideal candidate will have a full background within the Agricultural Sales and be able to demonstrate confidence in building relationships in this Sector.

You will take ownership of customer opportunities from initial enquiry through to specification, quotation, order, delivery and commissioning. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating both commercially and technically, with the ability to understand a customer's requirements, design an appropriate solution and confidently support that solution through to successful operation.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced technical sales professional looking for a role with genuine autonomy, customer contact and the opportunity to make a significant contribution to business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Sales & Business Development
· Take ownership of sales performance, revenue growth and agreed sales targets.
· Identify, develop and convert new business opportunities across the UK and, where appropriate, European markets.
· Develop key accounts, tenders, partnerships and dealer/distributor opportunities.
· Build and manage a strong sales pipeline from initial enquiry through to order.
· Develop long-term relationships with customers across agriculture, commercial and specialist markets.
· Negotiate and close sales with a strong understanding of price, margin, cost, value and customer requirements.
· Provide regular sales forecasts, pipeline updates, performance reports and market intelligence to senior management.
Technical Sales & System Design
· Visit customer sites to understand their operational and technical requirements.
· Assess factors including water availability, flow, pressure, field layout, distances, topography, crop requirements and irrigation strategy.

· Apply a strong practical understanding of hydraulics, pumps, flow, pressure, hose sizing and water application rates.
· Ensure proposed solutions are technically sound, commercially viable and suitable for real-world operating conditions.
· Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of products, technology and developments within the irrigation and agricultural engineering sectors.
Commissioning & Field Support
· Attend customer sites to support installation, commissioning and handover of equipment.
· Ensure systems are correctly configured, calibrated and operating effectively.
· Troubleshoot technical and practical issues in the field.
· Work closely with internal engineering and production teams to resolve issues where required.
· Provide customer training and operational guidance.
· Gather customer and field feedback to support product development and continuous improvement.
Aftermarket & Customer Development
· Identify opportunities for spare parts, consumables, upgrades and system enhancements.
· Develop repeat business through strong customer relationships and ongoing account management.
· Identify opportunities to improve customer performance, water efficiency and system reliability.
· Support customer retention through proactive contact and technical support.
Internal Collaboration

You will ideally have:
· At least 5 years' experience in sales, ideally within irrigation, agricultural engineering, water systems, pumps, machinery or a related technical sector.
· A proven track record of generating sales, winning new business and delivering against revenue targets.
· Experience specifying and delivering technical products or systems in real-world operating environments.
· A practical understanding of irrigation systems and their application across different soils, crops and operating conditions.
· Good knowledge of flow, pressure, hydraulics and pump selection.
· An understanding of hose sizing, nozzle selection, application rates and irrigation performance.
· Experience of installation, commissioning, field support or technical customer support would be highly advantageous.
· Strong commercial awareness, including pricing, margin and negotiation.
· Excellent communication, presentation and relationship-building skills.
· The ability to manage a sales pipeline and provide accurate forecasts and reporting.
· A practical, hands-on approach and the confidence to work independently with customers.
· A willingness to travel extensively throughout the UK, with European travel as required.
· Fluent English; an additional European language would be advantageous.
A degree or equivalent qualification in Business, Agriculture, Engineering, Water Management or a related discipline would be beneficial, although relevant practical industry experience will be equally valued.

Transport experience. Customer focus. Ambition to progress.
Are you ready to take your transport career to the next level?
We’re looking for a high-energy, ambitious Transport Account Manager to take ownership of a key client relationship within a fast-paced and commercially driven transport environment.
This isn’t a traditional account management role.
We need someone who understands transport from the inside out - someone who knows the pressures of planning, operations, service delivery and customer expectations, but who also has the personality and drive to build exceptional client relationships.
You’ll be the person the customer trusts to get things done.
What will you be doing?
You’ll take ownership of a key strategic account, becoming a trusted partner to the client and the link between their expectations and the operational teams delivering the service.
You’ll be responsible for:
· Building a strong, credible and trusted relationship with the customer.
· Understanding their operation, challenges, priorities and future requirements.
· Working closely with transport planning and operational teams to deliver outstanding service.
· Taking ownership when things go wrong - finding solutions rather than finding excuses.
· Anticipating issues and acting before they become problems.
· Monitoring performance and driving improvements across the account.
· Managing KPIs, service levels and customer expectations.
· Leading performance conversations and identifying opportunities to add greater value.
· Challenging the status quo and looking for smarter, more effective ways of working.
· Ensuring the customer feels listened to, supported and genuinely valued.
· Ultimately, making the account successful.
What are we looking for?
Transport experience is essential.
You could be coming from a transport planning, operations, logistics, customer service or existing account management background.
What matters is that you understand how transport actually works and can combine that knowledge with exceptional customer service and relationship-building skills.
We’re looking for someone who can walk into a conversation with a customer and understand not just what they want, but why they want it - and what it will take operationally to deliver it.
You’ll need:
· Proven experience within transport and logistics.
· A strong understanding of transport operations and planning.
· Exceptional customer service and communication skills.
· Experience dealing directly with customers and key stakeholders.
· Strong commercial awareness and a results-driven approach.
· The confidence to influence, challenge and negotiate when required.
· Excellent problem-solving skills.

30 hours per week (approx.) - Monday to Friday

Key responsibilities will include:
· Acting as PA to the Managing Director, including drafting emails, letters and other correspondence on his behalf.

· Taking ownership of tasks and ensuring matters are followed through to completion.
The Person
Personality and attitude are particularly important.
We are looking for somebody who is:
· Proactive, resourceful and able to use their own initiative.
· Highly organised and able to manage several very different matters at once.
· Confident and capable of dealing with customers, suppliers, employees, councils and professional advisers.
· Commercially aware and naturally inclined to research solutions and identify opportunities for improvement.
· Able to take ownership of a matter and progress it without needing a detailed list of instructions.

· Down-to-earth, practical and happy working within a close-knit family business.
· Willing to get involved and help wherever reasonably needed rather than being constrained by a rigid job description.
The successful candidate needs to be comfortable taking initiative while also working closely with a Managing Director who remains actively involved in the business and retains final sign-off on decisions.

This is a traditional, hands-on and fully office-based environment. The role is 30 hours per week across five days, so regular day-to-day presence within the business is important.

An interest in property or farming would be advantageous but is not essential. More important is somebody who is interested and capable enough to get to grips with unfamiliar subjects, carry out research, speak confidently to the relevant people and clearly summarise the position for the Managing Director.
Specific Health & Safety, payroll, property or agricultural qualifications are not required.

· Perform defined measurements and inspections and accurately record results in the relevant database.
· Maintain full material and reel traceability.

o Long-term storage

· Carry out routine equipment checks and basic troubleshooting.
· Report equipment faults and support corrective actions as required.

· Good practical problem-solving skills.
· The ability to follow written procedures and work instructions.
· Good computer skills and confidence working with databases or production records.
· The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a wider engineering/manufacturing team.

Experience within HTS, superconducting materials, advanced manufacturing, tape processing, metrology or a similar technical environment would be advantageous, but is not essential.
